findings.title: Unauthenticated brute-force of 6-digit QR share codes exposes plaintext vault snapshots (passwords, contacts, CRUD records)
findings.attacker: Unauthenticated remote attacker on the public Internet
findings.controlled_input: POST body field code (six digits) or repeated guesses against modules/*/join.php public endpoints
findings.attack_path: Attacker POSTs share codes to a public join handler such as modules/passwords/join.php (ITM_QR_SHARE_PUBLIC skips employee auth in config/config.php). itm_qr_share_fetch_session_by_code() looks up share_sessions by module_slug plus share_code with no rate limit, lockout, or CAPTCHA. Codes are generated by itm_qr_share_generate_code() as random_int(0, 999999) padded to six digits with a 1800-second TTL. On match, join renders payload_json; password shares include decrypted password plaintext from passwords_share_build_payload_from_entry().
findings.impact: Recovery of active temporary share payloads without the 64-byte access_token, including decrypted passwords, private contacts, employee PII from CRUD record shares, and explorer file download links.
findings.remediation: Require token-only access for sensitive modules, increase code entropy (or drop numeric codes), and add per-IP rate limiting and lockouts on join POST handlers.

findings.title: RBAC can_view bypass on Attempts detail view exposes login audit data to roles without Attempts permission
findings.attacker: Authenticated tenant user whose role lacks can_view on Attempts (seed User/Helpdesk roles only grant Tickets)
findings.attack_path: After login with a low-privilege role, attacker requests modules/attempts/view.php?id=<record_id>. Handler loads the row with company_id scoping but never calls itm_require_crud_role_module_permission for view unlike delete.php which enforces delete permission. GET view path runs before any RBAC guard.
findings.impact: Read security audit rows (ip_address, email, attempt_source, attempt_type) for any attempt ID in the tenant despite RBAC denying Attempts view.
findings.remediation: Call itm_require_crud_role_module_permission with view action before loading or rendering view.php and index list GET handlers.

findings.title: RBAC can_view bypass on Email send log detail exposes tenant email metadata to unauthorized roles
findings.attacker: Authenticated tenant user whose role lacks can_view on Email Management
findings.attack_path: Attacker with session company_id requests modules/emails/view.php?id=<id>. Prepared SELECT scopes by company_id only; no itm_require_crud_role_module_permission or admin gate runs before rendering recipient/subject/status fields.
findings.impact: Read any tenant email send log entry (to/from/cc/subject/body metadata) by numeric id without RBAC approval.
findings.remediation: Enforce itm_require_crud_role_module_permission with view action on emails before loading the row.

findings.title: Hotel distribution outbound webhook delivery allows SSRF to internal and cloud metadata endpoints
findings.attacker: Authenticated user who can edit distribution channels or holder of a leaked channel API key
findings.controlled_input: webhook_url stored via modules/hotel_booking_distribution_channels/edit.php, triggered by Push ARI on view.php or hotel_booking_api action ari_push_outbound
findings.attack_path: Attacker sets webhook_url to an internal URL such as http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ and triggers outbound delivery. itm_hotel_booking_distribution_deliver_webhook_queue_row() POSTs with file_get_contents on targetUrl and no blocklist for private, link-local, or metadata addresses; response snippets are stored in last_error.
findings.impact: Server-side HTTP requests to internal services and cloud metadata from the application host; response bodies partially exfiltrated via queue error fields.
findings.remediation: Validate webhook_url against an allowlist, block RFC1918/link-local/metadata targets, and restrict channel edit/push to administrators.
